title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E4 — Limpin' Lizards
Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E5 — Free at Last
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E6 — Father Fairest
When Earvin tells Mark that his greatest wish is to see his long-lost father, Mark locates Earvin's dad and invites him to the Halloween dance with nearly disastrous results.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E7 — The Goodbye Girl
Mark persuades Geneva to use "reverse psychology" on the rebellious Nicole, and they let her do anything she wants to teach her that rules are important. Vanessa pretends to like sports to impress a man.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E8 — Seoul Shake
Mark learns that Earvin is prejudiced against Koreans when Mark puts a Korean boy on the basketball team.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E9 — The Prince Of Soul
When a man claiming to be an African prince proposes to Vanessa, Mark convinces her that the man is a clever thief trying to cheat them out of their home. Don Cheadle guest stars.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E7 — The Big Sleepover
George and Katherine are delighted when Webster makes a new friend and extends an invitation for a sleepover until they discover that Tony is a girl.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E8 — Secrets
The son of George's boss bullies Webster into doing his schoolwork, or else the kid will tell his dad to fire George.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E9 — A Test of Characters
Webster's crafts instructor takes credit for Web's winning picture in a photo contest.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E10 — Freedom of the Press
Webster's article in the school paper exposes the personal problems of a teacher Katherine is counseling.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E11 — Seeing It Through
Webster feels guilty that his success as a dog-walker comes at the expense of his predecessor; and the expense of home repairs spurs Katherine to try to fix things herself.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E7 — The Nutty Moesha
It’s Halloween and Moesha’s acting crazy, Niecy’s growing body hair, and Dorian’s dogsitting a ferocious bulldog.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E8 — The Candidate
A woman city council candidate loses Moesha’s support when she gets the hots for Hakeem.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E9 — Definitely Not The Cosbys
When Moesha tells her dad she’s engaged, he fantasizes about solving his family problems like Bill Cosby.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E10 — All This & Turkey Too
Q comes home for Thanksgiving and asks Moesha for his ring back.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E11 — The Player
Moesha’s attempt to solve Niecy’s 'ain’t gotta man blues' backfires.

S3 E17 — Rapture
When Pearl finds out that Calvin is failing his history class, Mary, Rose and Lester each take turns as tutor-in-residence.

S3 E18 — Sweet Sixteen
Though Brenda's but a week away from her sixteenth birthday, a milestone marking newfound dating freedom, Mary refuses to bend the rules and allow her to accept Calvin's invitation to the party of the year.

S3 E19 — Blues
When Brenda's grandfather gives her his treasured collector's blues recording, she accidentally scratches the record and learns first-hand what the blues are all about.

S3 E20 — The Roommate
When Mary and Lester assume the role of temporary foster parents, they're horrified to find Sandra's erotic lifestyle rubbing off on the impressionable co-ed.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E5 — Someday My TAFKAP Will Come
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E6 — Little Sister
Eddie is determined to keep Malcolm away from his younger sister.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E7 — Big Brother Is Watching
Eddie agrees to spend time with a ten-year-old boy in order to date a beautiful woman.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E8 — The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
Eddie fears a family curse will make him a werewolf on Halloween.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E9 — Dead Guy
After faking an injury in order to sue Malcolm and Eddie, an unruly customer suddenly dies in the kitchen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E15 — A Bedtime Story
George's problems in the bedroom send him on a panicked search for solutions, from some of the most unlikely sources.
